sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवो रामं रक्तान्तलोचनम् ।ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं काकुत्स्थं पुनरेव वचोऽब्रवीत् ॥४-११-७३॥।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu sugrīvo rāmaṁ raktāntalocanam ।dhyātvā muhūrtaṁ kākutsthaṁ punareva vaco'bravīt ॥4-11-73॥।।

translations.english: Having said this and thinking for a moment, Sugriva again said to the heroic Rama whose eyes had turned red.
